# Topic Review

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A structured retrospective evaluating a topic.

## Scope note

- Output of the Topic Review workflow: assesses the actual Topic Log against the Topic Plan intentions.
- Includes Plus-Minus-Next (PMN) analysis by Claude AI: what worked, what needs improving, and what's next.
